result.title: HumanCOIN: A 12,500-Hour Dataset for Human Intent in Egocentric Manipulation
result.summary: First-person manipulation datasets treat the observation-action pair as the atomic unit and compress the generation and execution of an action into a policy network's weights, rendering the intent state behind the action unobservable. Human motor control research shows that intent mediates between observation and action and leaves observable traces along the intent pathway from decision to effect: gaze reaches the target before the hand, muscle load builds before contact, and cortical activity precedes the motor command. To record this pathway at scale, we present HumanCOIN, a first-person manipulation dataset built around human intent: 12,500 hours across 38 scene classes with three tiers of proxies. At the output end, the L1 attention tier (10,000 h) infers gaze from headband camera video, exposing the operator's next object of attention and reach before the hand moves. Midway, the L2 exertion tier (2,000 h) records surface EMG from armbands, making load expectations readable before execution is complete. At the origin, the L3 cognition tier (500 h) records scalp EEG, giving early readouts of task decisions and monitoring. Each tier inherits all proxies from the tiers below. The dataset further provides multi-view RGB images, depth maps and point clouds, 6-DoF head and wrist pose, and step-level action and object annotations. The controlled L3 setting additionally measures gaze, hand pose and finger kinematics directly. Clock and calibration data are released with the dataset so that any read rate can be re-aligned. The three tiers cover three stations, from visual orienting to cortical preparation, making the process behind visual-action pairs available for modeling at dataset scale. Project page: https://flagopen.github.io/HumanCOIN.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HumanCOIN，一个以人类意图为中心的第一人称操作数据集，共 12,500 小时，按三层代理信号组织：从头带相机推断视线、记录手臂表面肌电、采集头皮脑电，并提供多视角 RGB、深度、点云与 6-DoF 位姿及步级动作标注。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作把「观察—动作」之间的意图状态当作不可直接观测的隐变量，并用先于动作的视线、负荷与皮层信号作为其可测代理，这可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的可观测代理设计及 LOOK/STOP 的时序监督提供旁证，但其本身不涉及视觉语言推理与生成机制，迁移线索需核查。
